description: 公开测量摘录；完整日志和 trace 保留在项目归档。数字沿用原始统计，不重新测量。

slo.goodput_denominator: full measurement wall time including final drain

deployment_comparison.handoff_timing: forward_wall_s is rank-0 host wall time through forward/copy synchronization. post_forward_wait_s ends at handoff ACK. handoff_active_s includes forward in layer-wise mode: it is not pure transfer time and is not plotted or stacked.
deployment_comparison.handoff_scope: P audit deltas include long warmups plus measured requests; D queue and long parity use measured requests only. Inline short gate is outside these deltas.

budget_comparison.limits: 每个配置只加载一次，随后连续测量各轮；这不是独立重启重复实验。配置顺序固定为 P4096 后 P8192，同轮输入与到达序列一致，跨轮到达种子不同。本次仅比较两种 PD 预算；普通部署的长输出未重新验收，即使 PD 两侧 hash 一致，也不等于普通基线正确性通过。图中 ITL 是请求内 P99 再跨请求取 P95；goodput 为同时满足 TTFT < 1 秒、请求内 P99 ITL < 50 毫秒的请求数除以整轮墙时，包含排空。
